note: Both sets capture the same core facts (composition ranges, 4-5% strain, 2-5% typical contraction, >25,000 PSI force, martensite/austenite structures, 25-50C hysteresis, 15-30C engineered transition temperature) with faithful quotes and correct conditions. Set A, however, repeats two claims verbatim (the 70C commercial transition temperature and the 15-30C diffuser transition range), adding redundant, trivial entries without new information. Set B is otherwise equivalent in accuracy, binding values to the right components and keeping conditions such as 'when heated' and 'low temperatures'. Both sets incompletely report the commercial transition temperature (source states 70C and 90C), so neither gains an advantage there.
